title: Chapter 106 — Delivery Operations
intro: The delivery machine — how it works, what can go wrong, and the salesperson's role in flawless execution.

sections.title: The Delivery Chain
sections.content:
A delivery starts when you close the sale and enters the system. From there: the warehouse picks the product, inspects it, stages it for the delivery day, loads it on the truck in route order, and the crew delivers it to the customer.

Every link in that chain is a potential failure point. The wrong product picked. Damage at staging. Wrong address on the route. Crew arrives at an unprepared home. Each failure traces back to information — and you are the source of most of that information.

Your delivery ticket is the DNA of the delivery. Model number, colour, address, contact phone, delivery window, installation type, haul-away, special instructions, access notes. If it is not on the ticket, the crew does not know about it.

sections.title: What Can Go Wrong
sections.content:
Wrong product loaded: happens when model numbers are transposed or colours are not specified. Wrong address: happens when the delivery address differs from the billing address and nobody noted it. Unprepared home: customer did not clear the path, did not disconnect the old unit, did not have the water supply accessible. Crew refused haul-away: old unit is in a location that was not communicated — basement, tight stairway, disconnected.

All of these are preventable with accurate, complete information at the point of sale and a pre-delivery confirmation call.

sections.title: Your Role
sections.content:
Verify every detail on the delivery ticket before it leaves your hands. Call the customer 48 hours before delivery to confirm access, readiness, and expectations. If anything changes — model swap, date change, additional items — update the ticket immediately.

The delivery team is the last face the customer sees. Make sure they have everything they need to deliver a flawless experience. Your commission depends on the sale. Your reputation depends on the delivery.
